source_identity: Exact City ABQ View / ABQ Dashboard / Transportation directory, linking seven distinct anonymous-access IBM Cognos reports on newpublicreports.cabq.gov. Original directory URL preserved; resolved Cognos report IDs and paths recorded in render-22..28.json.
current_usability: Directory and all seven linked reports rendered at 1440x1000 in installed Chrome without sign-in, broken report, replacement state or JavaScript page error. Actual labeled bar charts loaded, with units/year axes, numerical values and definitions. No geographic layers or substantive data filters/tabs; report shell offers run/format controls, whose export modes were not tested.
mission_scope: City Aviation and Transit Department measures of Albuquerque Sunport activity, airport revenue productivity, ABQ RIDE fixed-route use/productivity and local Sun Van ridership.
specific_albuquerque_connection: Ninety-five annual observations concern Albuquerque airport/passenger revenue and City bus/paratransit services, with named City departments and measure contacts.
exclusion_test: Direct measured performance of Albuquerque public transport infrastructure/services, not generic transportation context or incidental local statistics. A multi-measure time series has material public-information value beyond the index contacts and application shell.
information_density: Complete seven-chart family, 95 labeled annual values: annual commercial flights FY2006-2018 (13 values); aviation passengers FY2007-2020 (14); revenue per passenger boarding FY2007-2018 (12); fixed-route passenger boardings per hour, per mile, Sun Van ridership and fixed-route annual ridership FY2007-2020 (14 each). Report definitions identify revenue-hour/mile denominators, fixed-route versus paratransit trips and FY2010 revenue-hours methodology change. Charts are dense visual statistical records despite limited prose.
unique_public_information_value: Curated family exposes comparable historical demand/productivity series: fixed-route ridership peaks at 13,009,047 in FY2014 and ends at 7,670,422 in FY2020; per-hour measure ends at 19.3 and per-mile at 1.56 in FY2020; Sun Van ends at 197,256 in FY2020. This supports understanding long-run City service performance. Value resides in all seven charts together, not individual sparse reports or claims of current performance.
currentness: Reports are usable now, but flight/revenue charts end FY2018 and aviation-passenger/all transit charts end FY2020. No dataset refresh indicator or newer year selector observed. The FY2010 revenue-hours definition change constrains comparison. Website copyright 2026, live Cognos execution and browser refresh are not evidence of current transportation data; qualification as historical performance is mandatory.
family_canonical_relationship: Seven report members remain grouped through one City canonical directory. Exact directory/report IDs absent from current public content. Existing ABQ RIDE planning/redesign reports, Sun Van guide/metrics draft, Sunport plan and budgets are contextual family sources, not the same seven-series visualization. Do not duplicate the individual Cognos reports, or confuse this evidence with the optional Sunport archive-policy hold. No row outside the nine is reviewed or changed.
intended_publication_form: One live official directory/reporting-service resource labeled historical charts, in content/maps-data/dashboards.md. No static PDF is approved or added; no R2/archive exception. Any future extracted report/document requires its own static review/archive workflow.
visual_observation: Personally inspected render-21 directory and every render-22..28 report screenshot. Labeled FY axes and 95 bar values are visible; JSON DOM text omits rasterized chart values, so this review explicitly records observed periods/endpoints. Seven report titles, definitions and resolved identities are also durable in frame evidence; screenshots stay ignored with durable SHA-256/path receipts.
implementation_ready_recommendation: Separate reviewed content PR: one entry titled City Transportation Performance Charts (historical) in maps-data/dashboards.md, linking original directory. Describe annual airport flights/passengers/revenue and ABQ RIDE/Sun Van usage/productivity; explicitly state visible reports end FY2018 or FY2020 and do not show current service performance. Keep charts grouped; no seven-entry expansion or unrelated Sunport policy action.
